description: Closed-aircraft source of truth after the latest model run. Use this file for UAV specs; resolved_configuration.json also contains template/calibration seeds that are not closed-run values.

model.name: H2AIR Integrated Model
model.description: Single-entry H2AIR model with separated user inputs, automatic lifting-surface sizing, measured linear-mass manufacturing model, polar-based airfoils, CAD export, discrete hardware selection and IE-SOAR cross-fuselage cooling integration.

run.fidelity_note: Integrated-v4 closure/optimization is screening fidelity. Airfoil polars are used directly where supplied; missing airfoils retain explicit screening fallbacks. Selected motor/prop/battery data remain subject to supplier/bench validation and pusher forward-flight correlation.

main_wing.note: Screening polar approximating NACA 6415 at Re 2e5 (alpha0~-5, CLmax~1.55 in polar; CLmax_screen 1.37 for area sizing). Replace with measured/XFOIL at flight Reynolds before design freeze.

horizontal_tail.note: Uses the user-supplied XFOIL polar table directly. Values outside the table alpha range are clamped, not extrapolated.

vertical_tail.note: Uses the user-supplied XFOIL polar table directly. Values outside the table alpha range are clamped, not extrapolated.
